title: Haye Afsos Raha
body:
haye afsos raha sab ko afsos raha
<<DIVIDER>>
itna mauqa ali akbar ko qaza ne na diya
maa tadapti rahi dulha bhi banane na diya
<<DIVIDER>>
jaane kya soch ke seene se ali akbar ne
haath baba ko bahot dayr hatane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
laashe akbar pe ye kehti thi tadap kar laila
fayeda koi tujhe maa ki dua ne na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
le gayi cheen ke baba se ajal akbar ko
khat bhi hamsheer ka bhai ko sunane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
baap sharminda hai is aalame ghurbat ne mujhe
chand khatre tujhe pani bhi pilane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
lag gayi maut ki bhar poor jawani mein nazar
haye taqdeer ne sehra bhi sajane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
maut se sirf rahega ye gila akbar ko
jo tha sughra se wo waada bhi nibhane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
kaise uthega zaeefi mein janaza uska
baap ko jisne kabhi ranj uthane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
lag gaya chand ko laila ke gehen maqtal mein
maa ke armaano ko parwaan chadhane na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
<<DIVIDER>>
keh ke roti thi yehi aamir o akhtar ek maa
kaun sa zakhm mujhe karbobala ne na diya
itna mauqa ali akbar ko...
author: Akhtar Sirsvi
